description: Stoplight Range — instant, at-a-glance status for any KPI Stoplight Range turns a single measure into a familiar, instantly readable traffic-light indicator. You define the value ranges that matter to your business; the visual evaluates your metric and lights up the housing whose range the value falls into — in the color, brightness and indicator you choose. Built entirely in SVG, it renders a photorealistic stoplight with a lens that glows in the range color, so status jumps out from any report or dashboard. WHAT IT DOES (THE OFFER) Stoplight Range maps any number to user-defined ranges and communicates the result as a glowing stoplight. Highlights: • Value-in-range logic — set the start of each range (up to 20) and an optional ceiling; the visual finds the matching range and lights it. • Single or multiple housings — show one compact indicator, or one housing per range (a classic stacked stoplight or a horizontal bar) where only the active range lights and the others stay dimmed, so viewers see where the value sits along the whole scale. • Rich indicators — display arrows, math and status symbols, the digits 0–9, or your own image inside the lens, rendered as an LED matrix in the range color. • Photorealistic housing — real metal, hood and chrome ring, with a glow, halo and hood shadow composed in code so any color looks natural.
